description: Setup → Organizations & projects (Build.Rite): the Visual Builder Studio organizations the team works in (their address and sign-in, kept encrypted on this PC) and their projects, each added by its Git address and checked: its branches and build jobs (desktop/lib/vbs.js).

available.description: Organizations and projects run in the desktop app only (the sign-in is kept on this PC).

selOrg.description: The organization shown on the right.

formOrg.description: The organization form is open (new, or editing editId).

oPass.description: Typed, sent once when saved, then cleared: never read back.

result.description: { ok, text } of the last action.

found.description: Find in VB Studio: the organizations, projects (their Git addresses) and workspaces read from VB Studio's pages (desktop/lib/vbsLearn.js).

watching.description: The VB Studio window is open: what it finds is read again every few seconds.

syncing.description: Sync from VB Studio (API) is running: its steps read again every second or so.

syncOpen.description: What the last sync did, shown open (right after it ran).
